verdict.rationale: The core inference functionality (model access, routing, BYOK, caching, provider options, embeddings) is fully API-driven and documented, and even the models list is available via an unauthenticated API endpoint. However, several UI-centric management features—budget setting, usage dashboards, and the Logs/Requests page—are described only as UI screens with no documented API/CLI equivalent for setting budgets or querying usage/logs programmatically. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for setting spend budgets, retrieving usage metrics, and querying/exporting request logs to match UI capabilities.
